column1: # Tools this repo's configs expect, read by installer.sh.
# Columns (tab-separated): command  group  arch-package  apt-package  note
# group: core (shell and scripts), nvim (Neovim, its plugin builds and mason),
#        extra (opt-in desktop tools; never needed on a server)
# "-" means the distro has no fitting package: installer.sh prints the note.
# A command with several packages lists them space-separated.

column5: apt's fzf is too old for `fzf --zsh` (needs 0.48+): git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/junegunn/fzf ~/.fzf && ~/.fzf/install --bin, then link ~/.fzf/bin/fzf into ~/.local/bin
Debian/Ubuntu name it fdfind: ln -s $(command -v fdfind) ~/.local/bin/fd
Debian/Ubuntu name it batcat: ln -s $(command -v batcat) ~/.local/bin/bat
apt's neovim is too old: use the release tarball, see README "Build Neovim"
blink.cmp builds its fuzzy matcher with cargo
mason builds gopls, jq-lsp and delve with go
mason's pyright, prettier, markdownlint need node and npm
desktop only: never on a server
used through the alias in .zshrc (bing engine)
